'''Zandoo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who lived during latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and at some point she came to owe the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] a large sum of money.

{{RPG|''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Dooku's Secret Army]]''}}
In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Zandoo overheard a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] claiming to have made a large amount of money from a deal with an old man named "[[Dooku/Legends|Dodo]]." Seeing an opportunity to make a profit, Zandoo contacted her acquaintance [[Trantos]], a Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] whom she believed would be interested in the information, and arranged to rendezvous with Trantos on the waterworld [[Xxan]]. Zandoo met with Trantos and a [[Plo Koon's Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Acquos]] on Xxan, and she suggested that, in return for a payment, she put the pair into contact with a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] ship-dealer fired of hers, who had placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]] aboard the bounty hunter's vessel. The trio met with the Rodian and learned that the bounty hunter had traveled to the planet [[Pzandias/Legends|Pzandias]], and they planned to journey to the world and further investigate the individual's dealings. However, en-route to the Acquos [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Zandoo, Trantos and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] were captured by a bounty hunter who sought to recover Zandoo's debt to Jabba.
{{Endgame}}
